ctx.x: Slim Gaillard, yes. And they -- Slim fired him in Chicago, so he fired him in Chicago, then we got together. He got fired, so then we got together and started doing some dates around Chicago. Go up to Milwaukee and Michigan and just all right around in there.
So I did those dates, dates like those, up until they wanted us to go south. And I went down south, Memphis and through Mississippi, all down through there.
